answer: When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 3 times its size, so a group of 31 keys loses far more than 31 single identities would. The voyage graph is rebuilt each epoch, thus the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the karst audit merges it again. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the raven checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
